turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! Happy Monday. How is your week starting out in Portland?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey there! It's starting out pretty well, thanks. Had a relaxed morning and made myself a bowl of oatmeal for breakfast before heading out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oatmeal is a solid, warm start for a cold December morning. Did you manage to squeeze in a workout today too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I got a session in with some gym weights during my lunch break. Felt good to get some lifting in.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice! Doing some gym weights is a great way to break up the workday. How are things at school? I imagine the science department is pretty busy right before the holiday break.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Extremely busy. Grading lab reports and finalizing everything before the winter break starts. Grace and I are both looking forward to some time off.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! Speaking of time off, how are the plans coming along for your family trip to Japan next spring?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They're coming along! We've been looking at train routes and booking a few stays. Grace is helping map out the Tokyo portion. It's getting exciting.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds amazing, it will be here before you know it. Do you have any plans to unwind tonight after such a busy day at school?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, I'm just planning on keeping it low-key. I think I'll just zone out and watch some sitcom reruns on TV tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sometimes a few sitcom reruns are exactly what you need to shut your brain off. Have you had any time for your woodworking projects or tennis lately, or has school taken over?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Tennis has been on hold with the cold weather, but I'm hoping to get back into the workshop for some woodworking once the break officially starts. For tonight, though, it's strictly couch duty.
